display.name: Users & Growth
display.description: Observed product activity derived from Keeper.sh logs. This dashboard does not claim authoritative registrations, total accounts, subscriptions, or retention because those require database/business events that are not currently exported. Plan filtering applies only where telemetry carries user.plan.

display.name: Observed API Users
display.description: Distinct identified users seen in keeper-api completions during the selected range. This is observed activity, not total accounts.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan')))

display.name: New-Account Activity Seen
display.description: Distinct users who made an API request while account_age_days=0. This is not an authoritative registration count.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractRaw(attributes_string['user'], 'account_age_days') = '0' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan')))

display.name: Users Completing Provider Imports
display.description: Distinct users with successful OAuth account-import completions (operation oauth-account-import). These events carry userId but no plan label, so the plan filter does not apply.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(attributes_string['userId']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'oauth-account-import' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success' AND attributes_string['userId'] != ''

display.name: Observed Sync Users
display.description: Distinct users represented in worker sync telemetry during the selected range.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan')))

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^((POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) /api/(accounts|sources|ical|tokens).*)$') AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan')))

display.name: Token-Authenticated Users
display.description: Distinct observed users authenticating with API or MCP tokens.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method'), '^(api_token|mcp_token)$') AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan')))

display.name: Observed Daily API-Active Users
display.description: Distinct identified API users per day by observed plan. This is DAU from telemetry, not billing/database truth. Daily buckets are UTC calendar days (Grafana used a rolling 24h window).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, user_plan ORDER BY ts

display.name: Observed Daily Sync-Active Users
display.description: Distinct users appearing in worker sync telemetry per day. Daily buckets are UTC calendar days (Grafana used a rolling 24h window).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, user_plan ORDER BY ts

display.name: Daily New-Account Activity Seen
display.description: Distinct users observed per day while account_age_days=0. It is a product-activity proxy, not a registration event. Daily buckets are UTC calendar days (Grafana used a rolling 24h window).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractRaw(attributes_string['user'], 'account_age_days') = '0' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, user_plan ORDER BY ts

display.name: Daily Configuration-Active Users
display.description: Distinct users per day changing accounts, sources, destinations, ICS settings, or tokens. Daily buckets are UTC calendar days (Grafana used a rolling 24h window).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^((POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) /api/(accounts|sources|ical|tokens).*)$') AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, user_plan ORDER BY ts

display.name: Configuration Operations per Hour
display.description: Product configuration attempts by normalized operation and outcome. Heavy users can contribute multiple attempts.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(3600, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^((POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) /api/(accounts|sources|ical|tokens).*)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, operation_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Provider Import Completions per Day
display.description: API-owned provider imports (operation oauth-account-import) by provider and outcome. Plan is unavailable on these background events.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, if(startsWith(attributes_string['provider'], '{'), '', attributes_string['provider']) AS provider, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'oauth-account-import' GROUP BY ts, provider, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Daily Users by Authentication Method
display.description: Distinct observed users per day per authentication method. Daily buckets are UTC calendar days (Grafana used a rolling 24h window).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method') AS auth_method, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method') != '' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != '' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, auth_method ORDER BY ts

display.name: Calendar Feed Responses per Hour
display.description: Public ICS feed delivery responses. These requests generally have no identified user or plan.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(3600, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])) AS status_code, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'GET /api/cal/[identifier]' GROUP BY ts, outcome, status_code ORDER BY ts

display.name: Passkey Flow Operations per Day
display.description: Passkey option, verification, registration, and management endpoint completions; not all are authentication attempts.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(86400, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(.*passkey.*)$') GROUP BY ts, operation_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Configuration Actions in Selected Range
display.description: Range-total successful/error product configuration actions by normalized operation.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^((POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) /api/(accounts|sources|ical|tokens).*)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY operation_name, outcome ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

display.name: Recent User-Facing Product Failures
display.description: Safe normalized summary of auth/configuration/API errors. Raw paths, tokens, and error stacks are omitted.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS time, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS op, toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])) AS status, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS slug, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS plan FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(.*(auth|accounts|sources|ical|tokens).*)$') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
